setup.zh: 雷泽白得晃眼。水中央立着一个东西——龙的身子，人的头，两只手不停地拍着自己的肚子。每拍一下，天上就炸一声雷。它脸上没有怒气，只有急。
setup.en: Lake Lei is a blinding white. In the middle of the water stands a thing with a dragon's body and a man's head, beating its own belly with both hands. Every beat is a crack of thunder. There is no anger in its face, only urgency.

text.zh: 是雷神。它不是在发怒——它在叫。鼎在它底下醒了，它的鼓停不下来。
text.en: That is the Thunder God. It isn't angry — it's calling. The cauldron woke beneath it, and its drum cannot stop.

text.zh: 雷神看见你了。它张了嘴，出来的不是话，是鼓点——你却听懂了：雨落田上，打一字。
text.en: The Thunder God has seen you. It opens its mouth, and what comes out is not words but drumbeats — yet you understand: rain falling on a field; one character.

exits.means: fights the creature, drives it down, stops the drum by force

withdrawn.zh: 雷神沉进水里，雷声远了。明日它还会敲。
withdrawn.en: The Thunder God sinks into the lake; the thunder fades. Tomorrow it will beat again.

text.zh: 雷神的手停在半空。它慢慢沉下去，肚皮上最后一声雷散在水面上。
text.en: The Thunder God's hands stop in the air. It sinks slowly, and the last thunder from its belly spreads out over the water.

text.zh: 水在往两边退。你看——湖心。
text.en: The water is drawing back. Look — the middle of the lake.

text.zh: 你答了。雷神的手停了。它低下头，像是终于被人听见了。
text.en: You answer. The Thunder God's hands stop. It lowers its head, as if someone had finally heard it.
It's drawing back. Now — the middle of the lake.

label.en: Yield · Step back to the shore

exits.means: yields, steps back, sits down and waits in silence, does as Shun did at Lake Lei

text.zh: 你退到岸上，坐下，不动。雷神拍了三下，四下——没有人再往前挤。它的手慢了，雷声一声比一声轻。当年舜在雷泽打鱼，泽上的人都把好位置让给别人。
text.en: You step back to the shore, sit, and do not move. The Thunder God beats three times, four — and no one presses forward. Its hands slow; each thunder is softer than the last. When Shun fished at Lake Lei, the people of the lake gave the good places to one another.
It's quiet. Come — the middle of the lake.

exits.means: runs away, leaves the lake, refuses to act

text.zh: 你往回走。雷声追着你。它不是冲你来的——它在求人。
text.en: You turn back. The thunder follows you. It isn't after you — it's begging.
